static_traits.name: Wesley
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young sibling
static_traits.social_status: Having friends to talk with, but not yet sharing inadequacy and self-criticism with anyone; interpersonal relationships tending tense due to needing external recognition and comparing with others
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; not yet received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, but overall negative and doubtful tone; marked self-deprecation and negative labeling; tending to focus on negative feedback, ignoring positive information; comparing with others; average cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: I am struggling with inadequacy and self-criticism, especially related to social media presence and self-image.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings are affecting my mental health and occupying my thoughts, affecting my daily life and relationships.
growth_experiences: Noticing declining engagement on Instagram posts a few months ago, and highly valuing others' views of social media presence, gradually developing inadequacy and self-doubt; initially moderate stress, but then escalating, affecting self-esteem and judgment of self-worth, triggering negative emotions when posts do not yet meet expectations.

Receiving specific negative feedback on animal sketches (such as 'the animal's legs look unnatural' / 'problems with proportion and anatomy'), internalized as negation of overall ability, with negative comments more salient in mind, leading to lost motivation for animal-related creation; also developing the fear of seeing oneself as 'not a real artist, just deceiving oneself'.

core_beliefs: I am not a real artist
I am not good enough / not worthy

special_situations.event: After posting works on Instagram, views and engagement markedly below expectations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If social media engagement is low, it means I have no value or am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Adjusting the content and frequency of posts, changing fitness and outward presentation, proactively seeking others' recognition and affirmation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The views are so low; I am just an idiot / terrible

special_situations.event: Receiving negative or picky feedback about animal drawings (such as 'legs look unnatural')
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others point out flaws, it proves I am overall no good, not a real artist
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles practice, follows online tutorials; at the same time avoids or reduces animal-related creating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough, deceiving myself into thinking I can draw animals

special_situations.event: When thinking about sharing inadequacy and self-doubt with friends, worrying about their reaction
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express vulnerability, others will look down on me or take me as complaining
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding sharing with friends, keeping silent to avoid being ignored or slighted
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not understand me, only not take it seriously

special_situations.event: Recalling praised works (such as a painting of a tiger) and positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only all works being perfect counts as qualified; individual successes do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles positive evaluations, continues self-criticism to force herself to improve
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: A few good ones do not mean I'm really capable

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen, recognized and affirmed as a 'real artist', and taken seriously
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, looked down on, or not taken seriously; worrying about appearing inferior in comparison and exposing not being good enough
defense_goal: Maintains self-worth by seeking external approval
Avoiding expressing vulnerability to reduce the risk of being looked down on
Uses self-criticism and higher standards to gain a sense of control over failure

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, possibly a fake artist
Vulnerable, someone who may be misunderstood
object_relations.object_representation: Friends who will not understand, may look down on or take one as complaining

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes one's successful cases or positive feedback and invites integrating them into self-evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to see this positive evidence as mere coincidence or not counting, worrying the counselor is ignoring the 'real problem'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Stating 'logic' in an objective, calm tone, downplaying emotional experience; emphasizing insufficient evidence, giving counterexamples, weakening feelings about positive experiences.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to consider sharing inadequacy and self-doubt with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing one's fear of being looked down on to others, believing friends will not understand or take one as complaining (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using hypothetical wording ('they will...' / 'they all...'), avoiding describing one's current feelings; cautious tone, vague, little first-person experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling or discussing critical feedback pointing out technical flaws in the work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning dissatisfaction or frustration with others into self-blame, believing flaws mean one is overall no good
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-deprecating statements (such as 'I'm just no good'), taking full responsibility, low tone, reducing discussion of external factors.

manifestations: Tightly binds self-worth to social media engagement volume
Negative feedback is highly internalized, positive feedback is hard to experience and integrate
Existential doubt about 'whether I am a real artist'
Having friends but not sharing inadequacy and self-doubt
Worries about being looked down on or treated as complaining; chooses to avoid expressing vulnerability
outcomes: Support system not yet effectively utilized

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism and labeling (such as 'I am an idiot')
Staying skeptical of positive evidence in counseling, emphasizing one's own inadequacy

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: Anticipating friends will not understand or will look down on oneself, thus avoiding sharing
Treats others' possible reactions as certain negative outcomes

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Weakening deeper exploration with a doubtful attitude (such as 'I'm unsure how helpful this is')
When touching on pain points, shifting to generalization or theorizing, reducing emotional contact

exception_events.target_problem: When creating animal-themed works or posting works, the client usually experiences self-denial and lost motivation due to negative feedback or engagement not meeting expectations.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once completed a tiger work and obtained much positive feedback; the audience praised the expressiveness of its fur details and eyes, showing they possess solid ability and aesthetic presentation.
exception_events.reason: Clues: paying more attention to details and eye expression in that work; the subject matching skills at the time; positive audience response, forming reinforcement.

positive_force: Having successful works and skill foundation (the tiger work was praised, details and expressiveness outstanding)
Has investment in practice and learning (follows online tutorials, tries to improve)
Having a potential friend support network (though not yet used, mobilizable)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external recognition to define self-worth (External Validation)
Tending to negate positive feedback, focusing on the negative (disqualifying the positive)
Comparing with others and self-labeling, enhancing the sense of inadequacy
Predictive worry about sharing vulnerability and mind reading (Fortune Telling/Mind Reading), leading to avoidance

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecating and negatively labeling speech (such as 'I am an idiot')
antecedent: Engagement below expectations after posting works
Receiving negative or picky feedback (such as animal legs unnatural)
Comparison situations when seeing others' works or data are better
target_behavior.core_reason: Highly binding self-worth to external evaluation, gaining control over failure through self-criticism; cognitive biases of catastrophizing and negating positive feedback present
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the pain of being negated by others (preemptive self-denial), gaining control or others' comfort in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, increased anxiety, weakened creative motivation, interpersonal tension, sleep and diet disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids or reduces animal-themed creative work; loss of motivation
antecedent: Associating criticism when thinking of animal paintings
Recalls negative feedback when preparing to start animal-related practice
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative feedback internalized as overall negation, worrying about failing again or being criticized; relieving anxiety through avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and criticism, lowering anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Less practice, hindered skill consolidation, declining academic and creative performance, further aggravating self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive comparison and seeking external validation (frequently adjusting posts, focusing on data and others' feedback)
antecedent: Paying attention to engagement metrics after posting social media content
When seeing peers' work or higher engagement
target_behavior.core_reason: Confirming self-worth through external recognition, hard to internalize positive experiences
target_behavior.consequence: Highly sensitive to negative data, intensifying emotional fluctuations, rising interpersonal tension and self-doubt, daily routine affected
